name: scholar-feed-mcp
description: Semantic search, citation graph, full text, embeddings, and BibTeX export over 600,000+ CS/AI/ML papers.
long_description: Scholar Feed gives your AI assistant a research copilot over 600,000+ CS/AI/ML papers: semantic search, citation-graph traversal, co-author graphs, full-text extraction, foundational-lineage lookup, text embeddings, and saved libraries, collections, and standing watches. Works anonymously at 100 calls/day, or 1,000/day with a free API key.

sf_api_key.title: Scholar Feed API key (optional)
sf_api_key.description: Paste a free key from scholarfeed.org/settings to raise limits to 1,000 calls/day. Leave blank for anonymous mode (100 calls/day).

tools.name: search_papers
tools.description: Semantic + keyword search over the 600k+ paper corpus.

tools.name: get_paper
tools.description: Full details for one or more papers by arXiv ID, including BibTeX.

tools.name: get_citations
tools.description: Citation graph for a paper, ranked by citing-paper impact.

tools.name: fetch_fulltext
tools.description: Extract the full text of an arXiv paper.

tools.name: find_author
tools.description: Find an author or look up an author's profile and papers.

tools.name: co_author_graph
tools.description: Co-authorship neighborhood for one or more authors.

tools.name: embed_text
tools.description: Embed text into a 768-dim vector for HyDE-style retrieval.

tools.name: get_field_orientation
tools.description: Candidate foundational papers, subfields, and open problems for a topic.

tools.name: get_foundational_lineage
tools.description: The foundational work for a paper's niche via the citation graph.

tools.name: find_gaps
tools.description: Surface important related work missing from a set of papers (requires a key).

tools.name: ask_library
tools.description: Answer a question using only the papers in your saved library (requires a key).
